environment: private staging, loopback requests only, serialized root-owned native operations

gates.start_condition: One owned reference evaluation is running; no unrelated queued or active work

failure_policy: Retain every failure; repair justified causes before a changed-source/protocol rerun; never repeat unchanged measurements to obtain a favorable result
submission_policy: Durable unique idempotency key before POST; reconcile lost responses through existing idempotency records, never blindly resubmit
completion: Verify source/image identity, exact owned submission terminal evidence and audit, idle queue, no owned workers, service health and unchanged private epoch/worker identity
